title: Persistent research assistant with hypotheses, evidence, experiments and audit
current_boundary: Core SQLite research store, evidence/experiment/skill records and audit; not yet wired into Atlas's production DB.

title: Continuously scan public web/social content
current_boundary: Configured RSS/Atom allowlist watcher and Celery Beat; selected OAuth APIs can ingest account-owned/exposed data. No universal or unlimited crawler.

title: Read Pinterest and any website/platform
current_boundary: OAuth Pinterest owned-Pin reader, generic bounded public URL fetcher; each domain and API must be configured/authorized.

title: Generate ideas from observed posts/trends/marketing
current_boundary: Source-diverse trend detection, research, competitor plans, venture hypotheses and content drafts; output is not proof of demand.

title: Reach out to people / organizations
current_boundary: Gmail individual send and LinkedIn/Pinterest single actions after payload-bound human approval; no unsolicited mass-DM engine.

title: Search opportunities and rank fit
current_boundary: Tavily web search, opportunity store/ranker and review packets; no complete global directory or assured eligibility.

title: Build application review packet from documents/profile
current_boundary: Opportunity packet and document upload/extraction with source provenance; Common App-specific official schema/export not implemented.

title: Submit/register automatically for all opportunities
current_boundary: Form helper stops at review; submissions remain user-controlled.

title: Learn preferences by quizzing during onboarding
current_boundary: Explicit preference interview with editable/erasable stored answers.

title: Copy entire human thinking/intelligence
current_boundary: Not scientifically established or implemented; preference/style profile is a limited substitute.

title: Implement 1,000 AGI concepts
current_boundary: 1,000+ generated research/product **hypotheses** exist; they are not 1,000 implemented capabilities.

title: Large autonomous agent troop
current_boundary: Configurable multi-role research critique/strategy/evaluation and four-timescale proposal coordinator; not a self-directed fleet with unrestricted tools.

title: Analyze successful people, ventures, news, books, podcast/music/video at internet scale
current_boundary: Search-backed source dossiers, bounded media/document ingestion, authorized account sources; no internet-scale exhaustive database.

title: Continuously train foundation model on every online post
current_boundary: Optional consent/licence-gated LoRA fine-tuning script and corpus manifest; no foundation model training or endless online retraining.

title: Deeply analyze product ingredients, founders, positioning, channel and weaknesses
current_boundary: Search query plans and evidence snippets for competitor analysis; needs verified sources and human synthesis for domain-specific conclusions.

title: Invent products/prototype from trends
current_boundary: Falsifiable venture hypotheses, validation plans and static-site prototypes; does not manufacture physical products or prove demand.

title: Build algorithms/tools for any company/industry
current_boundary: Bounded code-patch proposal agent and isolated Docker test runner; no general-purpose production deployment agent.

title: Reproduce human emotion/psychology “to the bone”
current_boundary: Explicit user choices and writing-style features only; no validated universal emotion simulator.

title: Create many accounts/bots and mass-repost altered content
current_boundary: No deceptive multi-account posting, spam, or fake-engagement automation.

title: Discover/install/integrate online tools automatically
current_boundary: PyPI metadata inspection and integration/coding proposals; no auto-install or auto-execution of arbitrary dependencies.

title: Read personal social feeds/likes/comments/follows/starred mail
current_boundary: User-authorized Pinterest owned Pins, LinkedIn authored posts if scope approved, Instagram professional account's own media/comments where granted, and starred Gmail metadata/snippets. Likes/follow graph and all private content are not supported.

title: Improve products based on follows/liked creators
current_boundary: Source/preference-driven ideation; no arbitrary follow graph, and superiority must be measured against a real baseline.

title: Build websites, software, games, anime, virtual people and publish
current_boundary: Static website prototype, content drafts, code patch proposals; Roblox/game/anime/3D-person publishing pipelines absent.

title: Personalized polymath career and college plan
current_boundary: Bounded goals planner, admissions research prompts and opportunities queue; no verified worldwide admissions rules database.

title: Achieve AGI/superintelligence or fully mimic humans
current_boundary: Not implemented; passing software tests is not evidence of AGI.

title: Send research to journals/universities/organizations with approval
current_boundary: Research dossiers plus approved individual Gmail send; no journal-specific manuscript submission API or automatic editorial compliance verifier.

title: Essay/olympiad/competition preparation and task management
current_boundary: Source-linked application packets, opportunity tracking, content drafts and form fill-for-review; no automatic entry/participation or guaranteed essays.

title: Win every scholarship/award/competition
current_boundary: External outcomes cannot be guaranteed.

title: Produce complete Common App preview from a prior portfolio ZIP
current_boundary: Document ingestion and structured review packets are available; no previous ZIP is magically read, and no final Common App integration/export is included.

title: Ingest huge amounts of data
current_boundary: Bounded file/feed/search ingestion with provenance; SQLite, no distributed ingestion/object store/production load-test.

title: Find every high-school competition
current_boundary: Search-assisted discovery and tracker; not an exhaustive, verified directory.

title: Build personal brand/content and grow audience
current_boundary: Content drafts/niche hypotheses and approved one-off posting to supported APIs; no live analytics or growth/revenue guarantees.

title: Make money/invest/trade/predict markets
current_boundary: Local paper-only simulator; no broker APIs, live trading or financial-advice guarantee.

title: Know all knowledge in the universe and invent any field
current_boundary: Literally exhaustive knowledge is not attainable and no universal intelligence is implemented.

title: Emulate conditions like autism/depression/savant syndrome as creativity modes
current_boundary: No diagnosis- or disease-emulation feature; task preferences are the supported approach.

title: Send compute-funding pitches to NASA/CERN/nonprofits with permission
current_boundary: Research/content drafting and approved individual email path; no vetted funder database or verified funding outcome.

title: Independently audit with ChatGPT/DeepSeek/Claude/Perplexity
current_boundary: Optional OpenAI-compatible/Anthropic providers and multi-role critique; independent model calls require credentials, and these are not external auditor attestations.

title: Make user the richest or guarantee fastest success
current_boundary: Not a verifiable or controllable outcome.

title: Compare up to 100 countries, all relevant colleges, full-ride aid and tests
current_boundary: Search-assisted admissions research/queue; no authoritative, maintained 100-country aid/admissions database or eligibility guarantee.

title: Produce 5,000+ page masterplan
current_boundary: Not produced; length is not a validity measure.

title: Scan Instagram, LinkedIn, starred email and every network for competitions, then fill/submit
current_boundary: Authorized narrow connector ingestion plus opportunity search and form-fill preview; no all-network sweep and no auto-submit.

title: Invent reusable abstractions and test held-out transfer
current_boundary: Bounded symbolic representation search plus separated training/validation/confirmation splits in core research lab.

title: Counterfactual world-model compiler
current_boundary: Candidate counterfactuals/interventions on supplied synthetic/suitable data; no universal causal-model compiler.

title: Fast/deliberative/learning/strategic timescale cognition
current_boundary: Four-timescale coordinator persists bounded proposals; independent continuous schedulers and actual tools execution remain integration work.

title: Verified skill genome with composition and evolution
current_boundary: Declarative allowlisted skills/tests in core bundle; not a general automatically evolving/composing skill language.

title: Information-value learning engine
current_boundary: Heuristic value ranking; not a calibrated learned policy for uncertainty, costs and expected transfer.

title: Proof-carrying cognition for every consequential action/claim
current_boundary: Provenance, audit hashes, test outputs and exact action permits; no formal proof for every claim.

title: Cross-domain transfer discovery and validation
current_boundary: Bounded transfer evaluator and held-out tests; no automatic universal transfer across arbitrary disciplines.

title: Invent new representational dimensions/latent-space phase transitions
current_boundary: Symbolic feature grammar search, not arbitrary learned latent dimensions.

title: Millions of diverse candidate minds selected for collective contribution
current_boundary: Bounded cognitive configurations/multi-role models; not millions of trained models or architecture-evolution system.

title: Invent entirely new experimental operators
current_boundary: Finite declarative intervention proposals; no unrestricted learned experimental ontology.

title: Explicit competence/ignorance map
current_boundary: Records domain outcomes and weak-evidence areas; does not guarantee identifying unformulable questions.

title: Machine-native emergent mathematical formalisms
current_boundary: Finite arithmetic DSL/formula search; no general new mathematics discovery guarantee.

title: Evolve evaluation criteria, validate them independently
current_boundary: Evaluator proposes missing metrics; independent held-out/third-party validation remains a research task.

title: Unified representation + experimental + learning discovery loop
current_boundary: A bounded research coordinator combines some searches; no autonomous self-training or AGI.

title: Analyze leaders/products/businesses and make improved alternatives
current_boundary: Search-backed competitor plans and source-linked hypothesis pipeline; not a universal business-building system.

title: Secret/classified government/elite project access
current_boundary: No unauthorized/classified access; only properly accessible public sources may be researched.

title: Generate viral apps/content on thousands/millions of niches
current_boundary: Combinatorial niche idea hypotheses and content drafts; no viral certainty or million-niche distribution engine.

title: Autonomously build digital companies with worker bots across all niches
current_boundary: Planning, code proposals, prototypes and research roles; no autonomous legal/business/finance/deployment worker organization.

title: Read every literature item/dataset and discover universal algorithms
current_boundary: Search-based research and bounded formula discovery; no exhaustive literature/data universe.

title: Merge strange/fictional concepts into testable prototypes
current_boundary: Venture hypotheses and prototype briefs/static sites; general multimodal product realization is absent.

title: Build and publish Roblox games, anime, agencies, virtual worlds, synthetic influencers
current_boundary: Static web prototypes/content plans only; those format-specific creator and publisher systems remain absent.

title: Affiliate marketing and monetization
current_boundary: No affiliate account, commerce tracking, payment or revenue system.

title: Build physical devices/products across all industries
current_boundary: No universal CAD/CAE, manufacturing, safety certification or supply-chain capability.

title: Try every possibility relentlessly until guaranteed goal achieved
current_boundary: Work is deliberately bounded, tested, rate-limited and approval-gated; there is no guarantee of a goal.
